title: Astragaloside IV confronts amyloid-beta-induced astrocyte senescence via hsp90aa1.
authors: Yan, Xia; Zeng, Rongxiang; Cao, Yajun
one_liner_zh: 研究黄芪甲苷通过hsp90aa1对抗淀粉样蛋白诱导的星形胶质细胞衰老，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cell senescence is intensively related to aging and neurodegenerative diseases. This study aimed to explore the effect and targets of Astragaloside IV against amyloid-beta-induced astrocyte senescence. Oligomerized amyloid-beta was prepared to culture with human astrocytes. The effects of Astragaloside IV were assessed based on SA-beta-gal staining analysis, senescence markers (p53, p16INK4, and p21WAF1), neurotrophic growth factor levels (qRT-PCR), and cell proliferation (CCK-8 kit). The targets for Astragaloside IV were predicted, and hsp90aa1 protein was verified using molecular docking. After hsp90aa1 overexpression, the effects of Astragaloside IV on amyloid-beta-induced astrocytes were assessed. Treatment of human amyloid-beta-induced astrocytes with Astragaloside IV can decrease the percentage of SA-beta-gal positive cells, downregulate the p53, p16INK4, and p21WAF1 levels, and increase the levels of neurotrophic growth factors (IGF-1 and NGF mRNA) and cell proliferation. Based on target prediction, hsp90aa1 was found to be a potential target of Astragaloside IV. Moreover, cellular experiments demonstrated that exogenously enhanced expression of hsp90aa1 overexpression suppressed the protective effect of Astragaloside IV on amyloid-beta-induced human astrocytes. The results presented here demonstrate that Astragaloside IV could confront amyloid-beta-induced astrocyte senescence via hsp90aa1, possibly opening new therapeutic avenues.
abstract_zh: 细胞衰老与衰老及神经退行性疾病密切相关。本研究旨在探讨黄芪甲苷IV对淀粉样蛋白-β诱导的星形胶质细胞衰老的作用及其靶点。制备寡聚化淀粉样蛋白-β与人星形胶质细胞共培养。基于SA-β-半乳糖苷酶染色分析、衰老标志物（p53、p16INK4和p21WAF1）、神经营养生长因子水平（qRT-PCR）及细胞增殖（CCK-8试剂盒）评估黄芪甲苷IV的效果。预测黄芪甲苷IV的靶点，并利用分子对接验证hsp90aa1蛋白。在hsp90aa1过表达后，评估黄芪甲苷IV对淀粉样蛋白-β诱导的星形胶质细胞的作用。用黄芪甲苷IV处理人淀粉样蛋白-β诱导的星形胶质细胞可降低SA-β-半乳糖苷酶阳性细胞百分比，下调p53、p16INK4和p21WAF1水平，并增加神经营养生长因子（IGF-1和NGF mRNA）水平及细胞增殖。基于靶点预测，发现hsp90aa1是黄芪甲苷IV的潜在靶点。此外，细胞实验表明，外源性增强hsp90aa1过表达抑制了黄芪甲苷IV对淀粉样蛋白-β诱导的人星形胶质细胞的保护作用。本文呈现的结果表明，黄芪甲苷IV可通过hsp90aa1对抗淀粉样蛋白-β诱导的星形胶质细胞衰老，这可能开辟新的治疗途径。
